title: Progress Map: a dated design record
description:
Where everything is now — and why it changed.

A file-and-code map for people who build software by talking to an AI every day. It keeps the *current* state of every file, and a change ledger in which **every edit carries a reason and a reverse patch** — tied back to the conversation section that caused it. No git.

A dated public record of the design. The implementation is not published. More: https://subtractlab.com
